5. For the point \( (20, 50) \):
   \[
   2 \cdot 20 + 7 = 40 + 7 = 47
   \]
   Since \( 50 > 47 \), the point is above the line.

The points above the line are \( (6, 20) \), \( (12, 35) \), and \( (20, 50) \). The sum of their \( x \)-coordinates is:
\[
6 + 12 + 20 = 38
\]
